settings.title: 01. Pack your stainless steel containers
settings.description: Fill the 3 containers (Carryo Large) or 2 containers (Carryo Small) with dal, sabzi, rice, or rotis. Place them inside the insulated bag and zip shut—your cord stays stowed in the front zip pocket.

settings.title: 02. Plug into any wall socket & flip the switch
settings.description: 20 to 30 minutes before lunch, plug the detachable power cord into the side inlet and turn on the inline switch. The LED indicator lights up as Carryo gently heats your meal with zero added water.

settings.title: 03. Unzip, eat hot, and wipe clean
settings.description: Open to freshly heated home food right at your desk. Wash the stainless steel bowls normally and simply wipe the waterproof interior lining clean with a damp cloth.

settings.question: What is the difference between Carryo Large and Carryo Small?
settings.answer: Carryo Large is our full-meal electric lunchbox that includes 3 stainless steel containers (1,350 ml total capacity)—ideal for dal, sabzi, rice, and rotis. Carryo Small is a sleeker, lighter 2-container version (900 ml total) designed for lighter lunches and compact commutes. Both come in all 5 colours with the same plug-in inline-switch heating.

settings.question: How does Carryo heat my food?
settings.answer: Simply keep your packed stainless steel containers inside the zipped Carryo bag, connect the detachable power cord to the side port, plug it into a standard wall socket, and flip the inline switch on. The LED light turns on and your meal heats gently to piping-hot perfection in 20–30 minutes—no water required.

settings.question: Which colours are available?
settings.answer: Both Carryo Large and Carryo Small are available in 5 colours: Black, Tan, Grey, Light Blue, and Light Pink. All finishes feature our textured premium leatherette exterior, matching handles, front zip pocket, back pocket, and metallic gold Carryo emblem.

settings.question: How do I clean the containers and the electric bag?
settings.answer: Remove the stainless steel containers and wash them normally by hand or in a dishwasher. For the heated bag interior, unplug the power cord completely and wipe the waterproof thermal lining with a soft damp cloth—never submerge the bag in water.

settings.question: Where do I store the power cord when commuting?
settings.answer: The detachable power cord with its inline switch folds neatly into the dedicated front zippered pocket, while the back slip pocket holds napkins, cutlery, or your office ID.
